archetypes.name: dyn-cli-path
archetypes.rationale: Changed shared CLI subprocess resolution and fallback diagnostics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the pr_body subprocess call sites for path correctness after the package move. Check that the LARCH_TEST_LAUNCH_CLAUDE_SUBPROCESS override still bypasses the shared CLI path. Verify stderr warnings remain bounded and do not corrupt stdout key-value contracts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
